role.label: role
role.definition: A standing job in the firm with a defined scope of authority, held by a human or an agent.
role.governance_note: A role is the unit of authority. Who holds a role determines who may do what.

mandate.label: mandate
mandate.definition: The written scope of a role: what it may decide on its own and what it must escalate.
mandate.governance_note: A mandate is the contract that bounds a role. Work outside the mandate must be escalated, not done.

lease.label: lease
lease.definition: A time-bounded permission to change something, so two parties never edit it at once.
lease.governance_note: A lease makes a change attributable to one holder for a known window.

gate.label: decision point
gate.definition: A point where work pauses until a human with authority approves or declines it.
gate.governance_note: A gate is where the firm stops and asks a person. An unanswered gate blocks the work behind it.

escalation.label: escalation
escalation.definition: Passing a decision up to a role with the authority to make it.
escalation.governance_note: Escalation routes a decision to the role that is allowed to own it; every chain ends at the authority.

a2h_session.label: work request
a2h_session.definition: A bounded task an agent has handed to a human, with a named deliverable and a way to return a result.
a2h_session.governance_note: A2H work is human work the firm depends on; it is tracked, not assumed done.

accountability_case.label: accountability case
accountability_case.definition: An open record of who was responsible for an outcome and what is owed to close it.
accountability_case.governance_note: An accountability case keeps a consequential outcome from being quietly dropped.

decision_right_basis.label: why this role may decide
decision_right_basis.definition: The recorded reason a role is allowed to make a given class of decision.
decision_right_basis.governance_note: Authority is never implicit; the basis says on what grounds a role decides.

operating_unit.label: production lane
operating_unit.definition: A typed contract for one kind of recurring work: who does it, and which finished states count.
operating_unit.governance_note: An operating unit bounds a lane of work so its output is checkable, not open-ended.

work_item.label: task
work_item.definition: One durable, claimable unit of work that flows through a production lane.
work_item.governance_note: A work item is claimed by one worker at a time and must end on a state the lane declared in advance.

governance_change.label: governance change
governance_change.definition: A proposed change to the firm's roles, mandates, or authority structure, awaiting approval.
governance_change.governance_note: A governance change alters who-can-do-what; it is a governed decision, not an edit.

actor.label: participant
actor.definition: An identified human, agent, or service that can act in the firm.
actor.governance_note: Every action is attributed to an actor; there are no anonymous changes.

actor_kind.label: participant type
actor_kind.definition: Whether a participant is a human, an agent, or a service.
actor_kind.governance_note: The kind of participant changes what the firm may expect of it and how it is held accountable.

authorized_paths.label: where this role may write
authorized_paths.definition: The parts of the firm a role is allowed to change.
authorized_paths.governance_note: This is the reach of a role's authority; '*' means unrestricted write access.
